args.summary:
Modeled a four-span cast-in-place prestressed continuous box-girder bridge (32+45+45+32 m, deck 12.5 m) as a 2D spine-beam on elastic supports (structure.idealization=spine_beam_2d, structure.system=continuous_on_piers, per MR-01/MR-05).

Key inputs and decisions:
- Section (cast_box, single-cell, h=2.2 m): integrated A=6.885 m², I=4.559 m⁴ (MR-02). Ec=34500 MPa (C50, JTG3362-3.1.5). γ=26.5 kN/m³ per owner override (MR-00); w=182.45 kN/m, m=18.599 t/m (MR-07, self-weight of girder only).
- Supports 0/4 (abutments) and 1/3 (Piers 1/3): PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric, 2 per line; support 2 (Pier 2): plain (fixed) laminated elastomeric, 2 per line. DOFs per MR-03 (sliding→longitudinally free; fixed→longitudinal spring). Bearing S, Kv (JTG3362-8.7) and Kh (0 for sliding, JTG3362-8.7-Kh for support 2, Ge=1.0 MPa default).
- Piers 1/2/3 as elastic beam-columns, twin 1.4 m circular columns merged to single column (A=3.079 m², I=0.377 m⁴, Ec=32500 MPa, lengths 6/10/19 m), base fixed (MR-06).
- Traffic: Highway Class I, one-way, 3 lanes (JTGD60-4.3.1); qk=10.5 kN/m; Pk=324/350/350/324 kN for spans 1–4; ξ=0.78.

Results: f1=2.686 Hz (impact factor μ=0.159, JTGD60-4.3.2). Self-weight reactions ≈2076/7739/8476/7721/2086 kN; max lane positive moment 11420 kN·m; max lane negative moment −9501 kN·m. All L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
